Subject: CAIQ follow-up: operational evidence requests

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the CAIQ package. The initial pass looks good, but our control reviewers flagged a few items where they need operational proofs rather than descriptive text. Specifically:

- CSA CCM: ID 'IAM-1' and subcontrols: we need a 30-day sample of privileged access reviews and a recent access revocation log entry.
- CSA CCM: ID 'LOG-3' — please provide an export (redacted) of the last 14 days of service-level event logs showing creation/deletion of API keys and role changes.
- Evidence mapping: for the controls you mapped to automated key-rotation, include the KMS policy snippets and an HSM attestation or vendor statement.

Can you confirm a timeline for delivery and whether you can provide small redacted samples (10–50 lines) for preliminary review? We can accept zipped text/CSV and PDFs for vendor statements.

If helpful we can share an example export format — cc'ing CloudAssure who will review the samples.

Thanks,

Jill Park
Senior Security Reviewer, Cygnus Security (Acorn Health)
cygnus-security@acornhealth.com
